answer: Operator Clawback Ledger: each wallet carries a signed operator certificate. A registry clusters wallets by control invariants—identical bytecode, key-derivation path, timing jitter, nonce cadence—and flags clusters above threshold. Penalty hits the operator’s payout account and API quota, not wallet balances: frozen revenue and revoked credentials. The mirror check exposes shared control; a fable of wallet bans becomes hollow because the attacker must provision distinct execution stacks and forfeit operator income per sybil.
